'''Cargo Supervisor''' was a [[Supervisor/Legends|supervisory]] role at the [[Estaria Central Starport]]. Cargo Supervisors were responsible for overseeing secure cargo storage, including short-term storage for small items. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Hev Lissona]] served as a Cargo Supervisor.<ref name="HS" />
